site.head.title: Mi.IA – the Chrome extension that answers your clients on WhatsApp Web
site.head.description: A WhatsApp Web extension with Mi.IA, an AI sales assistant: replies instantly, understands voice notes, explains financing, follows up with leads who went quiet and tells you when a client wants a visit. 7 days free.

curso.head.description: A step-by-step course: install the extension, connect WhatsApp, set up Mi.IA, import contacts and run your first campaign.

curso.008: Before you touch anything, get to know the three pieces. It takes a few minutes and makes everything else easier.

curso.013: Shows each client's card, the funnel, notes and quick replies

curso.039: It takes about 5 minutes. Do one step at a time and only move on when the previous one is done.
curso.041: You need Google Chrome on a computer. It doesn't work on a phone.
curso.042: Keep your phone's WhatsApp handy (we'll use it in the next lesson).
curso.043: You need the extension's .zip file that came with your invite.
curso.046: Put it in a folder that's easy to find, like your Desktop.
curso.048: Right-click the .zip and choose Extract All. Then click Extract. A new folder will appear.
curso.050: Copy chrome://extensions, paste it into Chrome's address bar and press Enter. Chrome won't open that address from a click, so you have to copy and paste it.
curso.052: It's the switch in the top right corner. It should turn blue, or on.
curso.054: The button appears in the top left corner once the mode is on.
curso.056: Open the extracted folders until you find the folder called MiZap. Inside it there should be a file called manifest.json. Select that folder.
curso.058: Go to web.whatsapp.com (or refresh the page with F5). The extension's sidebar shows up next to the chat.
curso.059: Don't delete the folder afterwardsChrome uses that folder to run the extension. If you delete or move it, the extension stops working.
curso.063: Chrome says it couldn't find the manifest
curso.064: You picked the outer folder. Open it and pick the MiZap folder, the one with manifest.json inside.
curso.065: An old version was already installed
curso.066: On the extensions page, click Remove on the old one. Then load the new folder.
curso.067: I installed Mi Zap and Mi Central together
curso.068: Keep only one turned on. Both use the same sidebar icon and get in each other's way.
curso.069: The sidebar doesn't show up in WhatsApp Web
curso.070: Refresh the page with F5. If it still doesn't show, check that the extension is turned on at chrome://extensions.
curso.071: Stuck?Talk to Mi.IA in the chat on the website and tell her which step you stopped at. She'll help you one step at a time.
curso.072: Create your account and connect WhatsApp
curso.073: Two things in this lesson: log in to your account and link your WhatsApp to Mi.IA.
curso.076: It's in the top corner of Chrome. If you don't see it, click the puzzle-piece icon and pin the extension.
curso.077: Choose to create an account with an invite
curso.078: It's the link under the “Entrar” (Log in) button.
curso.080: Invite code (8 letters and numbers), your name, your email and a password. Click Criar conta (Create account) just once.
curso.082: You'll get a message. Open it and click the confirmation link. Check your spam folder too.
curso.084: Go back to the extension and log in with your email and password.
curso.085: Your 7 free daysThe trial starts when the first agent at your company accepts the invite. During the trial, everything is unlocked, Mi.IA included.
curso.087: Mi.IA answers from your own number. You don't change SIM cards or numbers: you just scan a QR code, like you already do for WhatsApp Web.
curso.091: Open WhatsApp, go to Linked devices and tap Link a device.
curso.092: Point the camera at the QR code
curso.093: When it connects, the extension tells you on screen.
curso.094: Safety tipUse your work number if you can. That number will stay linked to Mi.IA.
curso.095: If the connection dropsRefresh the WhatsApp Web page. If it still doesn't work, generate a new QR code and scan it again.
curso.096: The sidebar and your daily routine
curso.097: This is where you'll spend most of your time. When you open a chat, the sidebar shows everything about that client.

curso.101: Mi.IA status: whether she's handling this conversation

curso.110: É cliente, sim (Yes, they're a client)
curso.111: Undoes the previous one. The contact gets answered again.
curso.113: Ready-made messages you use with one click. You can save them per property, like the address, how visits work or the list of documents.
curso.114: A simple routineIn the morning, open WhatsApp Web, see who's in “visit” or “hot” and start with them. Mi.IA has already left the card ready.
curso.116: When the client asks for a visit
curso.118: When the client has been waiting 20 minutes for a reply
curso.120: The funnel is your sales pipeline: each client sits in a stage, from first contact to closing. The stages are yours to define.
curso.122: You can use these or create your own:
curso.129: Rename: change the stage name to whatever makes sense to you
curso.130: Change the color: make the important stages stand out
curso.131: Change the order: put them in the order your sales actually happen
curso.132: Less is moreStart with a few stages. Five or six are enough for most agents. You can change them later without losing anything.
curso.133: Heads upOn the free plan you can only view the stages. To edit the funnel you need the Paid plan or the 7-day trial.
curso.134: Teach Mi.IA to talk your way
curso.135: On the Minha Mi.IA (My Mi.IA) screen you answer 8 questions. With them, Mi.IA learns who you are, what you sell and how to talk.
curso.140: “I'm Mi.IA, assistant to agent John at Horizonte Realty.”
curso.142: “South Zone of São Paulo and Greater São Paulo.”
curso.144: “New apartments, off-plan and ready to move in.”
curso.146: The name of each one and what she can or can't share.
curso.148: “Friendly and direct. Short sentences. An emoji now and then is fine.”
curso.150: “Household income, whether they have FGTS, whether they have a down payment, and the area they're interested in.”
curso.152: “When the client asks for a visit, prices, or to talk to me.”
curso.154: “Never promise financing approval, discounts or delivery dates.”
curso.156: Be specific. “Friendly and short” works better than “professional.”
curso.157: Write only what's true. Mi.IA uses what you write. If you put in wrong information, she'll repeat it.
curso.158: Use the limits. Everything she can't promise should be written here.
curso.159: Test and adjust. Send a message to your number, see how she replies and fix any answer that didn't come out right.
curso.160: <small>Example of a formal tone</small>“Very formal and polite. Always address people as sir or madam. No emojis. Short sentences. End every message with: I remain at your disposal.”
curso.161: Golden tipThe clearer you are about the limits, the safer you are. You're the one who decides price and terms.
curso.163: Here you see all your contacts together, filter them, import your list and export it whenever you like.
curso.166: Filters by property, stage and owner
curso.169: Column cut off?If a name looks cut off, drag the column's edge to widen it.
curso.172: A spreadsheet with three columns: nome, telefone and empreendimento (name, phone and property). Keep these exact column names. The phone number must include the area code.
curso.174: In Excel or Google Sheets, choose Save as and then CSV.
curso.178: The screen shows how many contacts were new, how many already existed and how many were invalid.
curso.180: Test firstThe first time, import a small spreadsheet with just 1 or 2 contacts. That way you see the result before importing the whole list.
curso.182: These are the ones without a valid phone number, for example with no area code or with letters. Fix them in the spreadsheet and import again. Contacts that already exist aren't duplicated.
curso.184: You can download your contacts whenever you like. Your data is yours.
curso.186: A campaign is a message sent to many contacts at once. In the extension it has safety steps, so nothing goes out by mistake.
curso.187: Read before you startBulk sending can get your number blocked on WhatsApp. The more messages per day, the higher the risk. That's why the extension sends slowly and only within set hours.
curso.191: The ad is the text of the campaign.
curso.193: Pick the right property. The Geral (General) option applies to every contact that doesn't have its own ad, so double-check before saving.
curso.195: The first message, short and friendly.
curso.197: The second, sent right after, with an easy question to answer.
curso.199: The property now shows up with a ✓.

curso.227: Message only people who know you or asked for information
curso.228: Use different messages and keep them short, never a wall of text
curso.229: Reply fast to anyone who answers. That's what keeps your number healthy
curso.230: Volume alertsAbove 40 per day you'll see a warning, and the extension asks for confirmation before creating. Above 100 you'll see a bigger warning. Sending is at your own risk.

curso.300: The questions that tend to come up at the start and as time goes by. Click a question to see the answer.
curso.302: Does it work on a phone?
curso.303: No. The extension works in Google Chrome on a computer, alongside WhatsApp Web. The phone is only used to scan the QR code.
curso.304: Does it work in another browser, like Edge or Firefox?
curso.305: The extension was built and tested for Google Chrome. We can't guarantee it works in other browsers.
curso.306: Does it work on a Mac?
curso.307: It works in Chrome on a Mac with the same steps. The only difference is extracting the file: double-click the .zip.
curso.308: Chrome shows a warning about developer-mode extensions. Is that normal?
curso.309: Yes. That warning appears because, for now, the installation is manual. Don't click disable. Once the extension is in the Chrome Web Store, the warning goes away.
curso.310: Do I need to leave my computer on for Mi.IA to reply?
curso.311: No. Mi.IA replies from the server, so she doesn't depend on your computer or on Chrome being open. Your phone does need to connect to the internet every so often: WhatsApp disconnects linked devices when the phone goes too long without a connection.
curso.312: Can I keep using WhatsApp on my phone as usual?
curso.313: Yes. You keep chatting from your phone and from WhatsApp Web. Mi.IA's conversations show up on your number.
curso.315: Install the extension again on the new computer and log in with the same email and password. Your contacts and settings live in your account, not on the computer.
curso.316: How do I update the extension to a new version?
curso.317: On the chrome://extensions page, click Remove on the old version. Then click Load unpacked and pick the MiZap folder of the new version.
curso.319: At chrome://extensions, click Remove. To disconnect WhatsApp, open WhatsApp on your phone, go to Linked devices and log out of that device.
curso.320: I forgot my password. What do I do?
curso.321: Talk to support, through the website chat or on WhatsApp, and we'll help you get back in.
curso.323: Does Mi.IA reply at any hour?
curso.324: Yes. She answers messages that arrive day or night. Only the follow-up with people who went quiet happens between 9 am and 8 pm.
curso.326: Yes. She transcribes the client's voice note and replies. She can also reply out loud.
curso.327: Does she talk about prices and terms?
curso.328: She only says what you've added and allowed. If you don't want her to share prices, write that in the Limites (Limits) question on the Minha Mi.IA screen. For example: “Don't give prices. Hand over to the agent.”
curso.329: Can she make mistakes or make things up?
curso.330: She's built not to make things up, and she only uses what you've added. Even so, no AI is perfect. Read the first conversations, adjust Minha Mi.IA when something doesn't come out right, and use the Eu assumo button when you want to talk yourself.
curso.331: How do I change the way she talks?
curso.332: Open the Minha Mi.IA screen and change the answers, mainly Tom (Tone) and Limites (Limits). The change applies to future conversations. Then send a test message to your number.
curso.333: Does she send photos and floor plans?
curso.334: She sends the information and photos from the material you added. Automatically reading a reference website isn't available yet.
curso.335: Does she talk to my friends and family?
curso.336: If the contact isn't a client, open the chat and click Não é cliente. Mi.IA stops talking to them. If you change your mind, click É cliente, sim.
curso.337: A client asked to stop receiving messages. What happens?
curso.338: Anyone who asks to opt out stops receiving messages. In campaigns, anyone who asked for SAIR never receives anything.
curso.339: How do I take over a conversation?
curso.340: Click Eu assumo in the sidebar. Mi.IA pauses in that chat only. When you're done, hand it back to her.
curso.341: Can I switch Mi.IA off completely?
curso.342: In the extension you pause chat by chat. To switch her off completely, talk to support.
curso.343: Will the client know it's an AI?
curso.344: We recommend that she introduce herself as the agent's assistant, in the Apresentação (Introduction) question of Minha Mi.IA. That makes it clear to the client who is talking to them and builds trust.
curso.346: How many contacts can I import?
curso.347: Start with a few to test, then import the full list. If the import shows invalid contacts, fix the spreadsheet and import again.
curso.348: I imported twice. Are my contacts duplicated?
curso.349: No. Anyone who already exists shows up in the summary as “já estava” (already there).
curso.350: Can I send a campaign to a purchased list?
curso.351: We don't recommend it. Message only people who have a relationship with you or asked for information. That protects your number from being blocked and respects data protection law (LGPD, in Brazil).
curso.352: I created the campaign and nothing was sent. Why?
curso.353: The Criar campanhas button creates drafts only. Sending starts only when you click Ativar. Check the time too: Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm.
curso.354: Can I send on Sunday or at night?
curso.355: No. Messages go out Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm. This protects your number.
curso.356: Why is the campaign so slow?
curso.357: Messages go out one per minute per number. That's on purpose: sending too fast is what gets WhatsApp numbers blocked the most.
curso.358: How many messages can I send per day?
curso.359: The default is 20 per campaign, and you can change it. Above 40 you'll see a warning and the extension asks for confirmation. Start small and increase gradually.
curso.360: I saved the ad for the wrong property. Now what?
curso.361: Before activating the campaign, check the list. If it's still a draft, don't activate it. Fix the ad in the Anúncios tab and create the campaign again.
curso.362: What do I do if my number gets blocked?
curso.363: Stop creating campaigns and talk normally with the people who reply. If WhatsApp restricts the number, you can ask for a review inside the app itself. We can't reverse WhatsApp blocks. That's why you should start small and use a work number.
curso.365: What happens when the 7-day trial ends?
curso.366: Your account goes back to the free plan on its own. Your contacts stay there. Paid-plan features stay locked until you sign up.
curso.367: What's the difference between the Paid plan and Paid with Mi.IA?
curso.368: Paid (R$ 199,90 per year) has all the tools, without the AI. Paid with Mi.IA (R$ 49,90 per month) has all of that plus Mi.IA answering your clients on WhatsApp.
curso.370: The payment method is arranged when you sign up. Talk to us through the website chat or on WhatsApp.
curso.372: Talk to support, through the website chat or on WhatsApp, and we'll take care of it.
curso.374: Talk to support to arrange it. We handle that directly.
curso.376: Does the extension read my conversations?
curso.377: The extension reads only the phone number of the open chat's contact. It doesn't read the text of the messages and doesn't send anything unless you ask it to.
curso.379: To reply, Mi.IA needs to receive the messages your clients send to your number. That's done on the server, and the text is used by an artificial intelligence service to put together the reply. Each company sees only its own data.
curso.380: Can another company see my contacts?
curso.381: No. Each company's contacts, ads and replies are kept separate.
curso.382: Can I take my contacts with me?
curso.383: Yes. You can export your spreadsheet whenever you like.
curso.384: Could WhatsApp block my number for using the extension?
curso.385: The extension isn't an official WhatsApp or Meta product, and tools like it carry risk. That's why sending is slow, only during business hours and with an opt-out option. Use a work number, start with a few contacts and message only people who expect to hear from you.
curso.387: Where do I ask a question that isn't answered here?
curso.388: Talk to Mi.IA in the chat on the sales page. She answers technical questions and walks you through installation. If she doesn't know, she hands you over to support.
curso.389: How do I describe a problem to support?
curso.390: Tell us what you were doing, what showed up on the screen and, if you can, send a photo of the screen. The clearer it is, the faster we can fix it.
guiado.head.title: Guided step by step – Mi Zap and Mi.IA
guiado.head.description: Do it together, one step at a time, like on a call: install the extension, connect WhatsApp, teach Mi.IA and run your first campaign.
guiado.003: Let's do this together, one step at a time.
guiado.004: It's like being on a call: I tell you what to do, you do it and press “Done, next”. The next step only shows up when you've finished the previous one.
guiado.005: If you get stuck, press “I'm stuck” and I'll show you what usually fixes it. You can stop and come back later: the system remembers where you were.
guiado.009: What should show up on the screen
guiado.js.all_done: You did it all: you installed, connected, taught Mi.IA and created your first campaign. If any question comes up, ask Mi.IA in the website chat or on WhatsApp.
guiado.js.well_done: Well done! Whenever you're ready, let's move on to the next block.

steps: Before you start
Let's install the extension. You need to be on a computer, using Google Chrome. It doesn't work on a phone. Have the .zip file that came with your invite ready.
You have Chrome open on your computer and you know where the .zip file is.
If you can't find the file, look in your Downloads folder or in the invite email. If you don't have the file, ask whoever invited you to send it again.
Save the .zip file
Put the file in a folder that's easy to find, like your Desktop.
The .zip file shows up on your Desktop.
If the file opened by itself or disappeared, look for it in your Downloads folder and drag it to your Desktop.
Extract the file
Right-click the .zip and choose Extract All. Then click Extract.
A new folder appears, with the same name as the file, next to the .zip.
If you don't see “Extract All,” you might be on a phone, or the file isn't a .zip. Check the end of the file name.
Open Chrome's extensions page
Copy the address chrome://extensions, paste it into Chrome's address bar and press Enter. Chrome won't open that address from a click, so you have to copy and paste it.
A page called “Extensions” opens, with a list (it may be empty).
If it doesn't open, check that you pasted it into the bar at the very top of Chrome and not into the Google search box.
Turn on Developer mode
In the top right corner there's a switch called Developer mode. Click it to turn it on.
The switch turns blue (on) and new buttons appear in the top left corner.
If you can't find it, look at the top right corner of the extensions page. If it was already blue, you're all set.
Click “Load unpacked”
Click the Load unpacked button in the top left corner.
A window opens so you can pick a folder.
If the button isn't there, go back one step: Developer mode has to be on.
Pick the right folder
Open the extracted folders until you find the folder called MiZap. Inside it there should be a file called manifest.json. Select that folder and confirm.
The extension shows up in the list, named Mi Zap, switched on.
If you get a “manifest” error, you picked the outer folder. Open one more folder until you see manifest.json inside it, and pick that one.
Open WhatsApp Web
Open web.whatsapp.com. If it was already open, press F5 to refresh the page.
The extension's sidebar shows up next to the chat.
If the sidebar doesn't show up, refresh the page with F5. If it still doesn't, check at chrome://extensions that the extension is on.
Don't delete the folder
Important: Chrome uses that folder to run the extension. Don't delete or move the folder after installing.
Nothing to do here, just keep it in mind.
If you deleted the folder by accident, repeat this block: extract the .zip again and load the folder.

guiado.blocks.n: Create your account and connect WhatsApp
guiado.blocks.fim: Your account is created and WhatsApp is connected.
steps: Open the extension
Click the extension icon in the top corner of Chrome. If you don't see it, click the puzzle-piece icon and pin the extension.
The extension's login screen opens, with the Entrar (Log in) button.
If the icon doesn't show up, click the puzzle piece and then the pin next to the extension.
Choose “create account with an invite”
It's the link under the Entrar button.
The fields for creating the account appear.
If you already created your account before, skip ahead to the login step.
Fill in your details
Type the invite code (8 letters and numbers), your name, your email and a password. Click Criar conta (Create account) just once.
The screen says the account was created and that you still need to confirm your email.
If it says the code is invalid, check the letters and numbers and whether it was already used: each code works for one person only. Ask whoever is in charge for a new one.
Confirm your email
Open your email, find the message and click the confirmation link. Check your spam folder too.
The link opens a page saying your email was confirmed.
If it didn't arrive, wait 2 minutes and check spam. If it still doesn't come, talk to support.
Log in to the extension
Go back to the extension and log in with the email and password you created.
The extension shows your screens, with the 7-free-days notice.
If it says wrong password, type it slowly and check that Caps Lock is off.
Open the WhatsApp tab
In the extension, open the WhatsApp tab.
A QR code appears.
If the QR code doesn't show up, refresh WhatsApp Web with F5 and try again.
Scan the QR code with your phone
On your phone, open WhatsApp, go to Linked devices, tap Link a device and point the camera at the QR code on the screen. Use your work number if you can: it's the one that will stay linked to Mi.IA.
The extension tells you WhatsApp is connected.
If it doesn't connect, the QR code may have expired. Refresh the page, generate a new QR code and scan it again.

guiado.blocks.n: Teach Mi.IA to talk your way
guiado.blocks.fim: Mi.IA now knows how to talk to your clients.
steps: Open the “Minha Mi.IA” screen
In the extension, open Minha Mi.IA (My Mi.IA). There you answer 8 questions, and with them she learns who you are and what you sell.
The list of questions appears.
If you can't find the screen, check that you're logged in and that the trial or the plan with Mi.IA is active.
Answer questions 1 to 4

1) How she should introduce herself. 2) The area where you work. 3) Type of property. 4) Properties, and what she can or can't share. Example: “I'm Mi.IA, assistant to agent John at Horizonte Realty.” Write only what's true: she repeats what you write.
The first four answers are filled in.
If you don't know what to write, copy the example and swap in your own details.
Answer questions 5 to 8

5) Tone (e.g. “friendly and direct, short sentences”). 6) What to ask the client (income, FGTS, down payment, area). 7) When to hand off to you (visit, prices, asking to talk to you). 8) Limits: what she must never promise, like financing approval, discounts or delivery dates.
All 8 answers are filled in and saved.
Be specific: “friendly and short” works better than “professional.” In the limits, write down everything she can't promise.
Test it by sending a message

Ask someone else to send a message to your number, or send one from another number, and see how Mi.IA replies. If any answer didn't come out right, go back to Minha Mi.IA and adjust the question that caused it.
Mi.IA replies in the way you wrote it.
If she didn't reply, check that WhatsApp is connected and that the chat isn't paused with “Eu assumo” (I'll take over).
Read before you start

A campaign is a message sent to many contacts. Bulk sending can get your number blocked, so the extension sends slowly (1 per minute), Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm. Only message people who know you or asked for information. Anyone who asks to opt out (SAIR) gets nothing more.
Nothing to do here, just read.
Always start small: 1 or 2 contacts the first time.
Import a small spreadsheet

Prepare a spreadsheet with three columns: nome, telefone (with area code) and empreendimento (name, phone, property; keep these exact column names). Save it as CSV. In the Planilha (Spreadsheet) tab, click Importar planilha (Import spreadsheet) and choose the file. For the first test, use just 1 or 2 contacts, preferably your own number.
The screen shows the summary: how many new contacts, how many already existed and how many were invalid.
If some come back invalid, fix the phone number in the spreadsheet (no area code or with letters) and import again.
Create the ad
Open the Anúncios (Ads) tab. Pick the property (the Geral (General) option applies to every contact without its own ad, so double-check before saving).
The ad screen opens, with the message fields.
If the property doesn't show up, check that it was imported in the spreadsheet.
Write Message 1

Short and friendly. Example: “Oi {nome}, tudo bem? Aqui é a Mi.IA, da Imobiliária Horizonte. Você pediu informações sobre o {empreendimento}. Ainda tem interesse?” (Hi {nome}, how are you? This is Mi.IA from Horizonte Realty. You asked about {empreendimento}. Are you still interested?) The extension swaps {nome} and {empreendimento} for each contact's details.
The message is written in the field.
Type the curly brackets exactly like this: {nome} and {empreendimento}.
Write Message 2 and save
The second one goes out right after, with an easy question to answer. Example: “Posso te passar valores e condições?” (Can I share prices and terms with you?) Then click Salvar anúncio (Save ad).
The property now shows up with a ✓.
If the ✓ didn't show up, click Salvar anúncio again and check that both messages are filled in.
Choose who receives it
Open the Planilha. All contacts come selected. Click Limpar seleção (Clear selection) and select only the ones who should receive it.
Only the contacts you selected stay selected.
If you selected the wrong ones, click Limpar seleção and select again.
Open Disparo and check
Open the Disparo (Bulk send). Check the groups: anyone marked “sem anúncio” (no ad) gets nothing. The daily amount starts at 20: start small.
The groups show up with the ad for each property.
If a group says “sem anúncio,” go back and create the ad for that property.
Create the campaigns (draft)
Click Criar campanhas (Create campaigns). This only creates drafts: nothing is sent yet.
The campaigns show up as drafts.
If nothing showed up, check that there are selected contacts and saved ads.
Activate the campaign
When everything is checked, click Ativar (Activate). Sending starts, following the schedule and the pace of 1 per minute.
The campaign shows up as active and messages start going out within the allowed hours.
If it's outside the hours (Sunday or after 7 pm), it waits and starts at the next allowed time.
